name: RingQ Free Live Chat, Calls & Messaging
author: ringqdeveloper32

sections.description:
Increase your online conversions with the RingQ Live Chat plugin. Chat and call
with your website visitors in real-time, and not only!

The plugin includes a complete communications system for your business – for free.
Call, chat, conference and collaborate with your teams and customers from your
office, home or smartphone.

Zero cost business communications from one central hub. Receive WhatsApp, Facebook
and SMS messages on the same dashboard as your live chats and calls.

Trusted by growing businesses worldwide, RingQ Live Chat is a reliable and
professional free live chat solution for WordPress.

NO HIDDEN COSTS
The plugin is free, forever. It’s not a free trial and we don’t ask you for your
credit card details. Simply create an account on the RingQ website, receive your
account details, login and start chatting!

VOICE, WHATSAPP & FACEBOOK!
•⁠ ⁠Receive and respond to WhatsApp messages
•⁠ ⁠Facebook and Text messaging too!
•⁠ ⁠Free calls – voice calls directly to and from the browser
•⁠ ⁠Answer, transfer and resolve customer queries on one platform across multiple agents
•⁠ ⁠Move to a new cloud phone system for free

Features

•⁠ ⁠Website Live Chat (and Call)
•⁠ ⁠Inbound WhatsApp, Facebook & SMS
•⁠ ⁠Video Conferencing
•⁠ ⁠RingQ Talk / Meet Links
•⁠ ⁠Mobile & Desktop Apps
•⁠ ⁠Hosted on Cloud
•⁠ ⁠Choose your SIP Trunk
•⁠ ⁠Ring Group
•⁠ ⁠Auto Attendant
•⁠ ⁠Multi-Agent Support
sections.installation:
1.⁠ ⁠Upload the plugin files to the ⁠ /wp-content/plugins/ringq-live-chat ⁠ directory,
or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
2.⁠ ⁠Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
3.⁠ ⁠Go to the RingQ settings page and create your free account.
4.⁠ ⁠Copy your account credentials and paste them into the plugin settings.
5.⁠ ⁠Customize your chat widget appearance and go live!
sections.faq:
Is RingQ really free?

Yes! RingQ Live Chat is completely free. No hidden costs, no credit card required.

Does it support WhatsApp and Facebook?

Yes. You can receive and reply to WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, and SMS messages
directly from your RingQ dashboard.

Can multiple agents use it at the same time?

Absolutely. RingQ supports multi-agent dashboards so your whole team can handle
conversations simultaneously.
